title: Cosmo asks the spend card twice: a Yes the route then refuses
description: Live 2026-10-21 01:51-01:52: Fabio clicked Yes on a Seedance 2.0 spend card, the run never reached generation.submit (refused by the connector generate route's own checks, unlogged), Cosmo retried and a second spend card asked again. The quote route skipped those checks, so the card priced a run that could not be sent. Quote now runs the same checks first (no card for a doomed call), and generate logs every refusal.
